Mai Gotō[https://twitter.com/gomatsubu/status/1168421843532836864 Mai Gotō on Twitter] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) }} '''Roxanne''' (Japanese: '''ツツジ''' ''Tsutsuji'') is the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Rustboro City]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as the [[Rustboro Gym]]. {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who defeat her receive the {{Badge|Stone}}. She is a scholar who [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Rock}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==In the core series games== [[File:Roxanne ORAS.png|thumb|left|200px|Roxanne challenging the player]] Roxanne appears in [[Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions|Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire]], {{v2|Emerald}}, [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire]] as the [[Gym Leader]] of the [[Rustboro Gym]]. She believes {{type|Rock}} Pokémon to be rock-solid, and her strategy is to use Rock-type power attacks. She became a Gym Leader so that she could apply what she learned at the [[Pokémon Trainers' School]] in battle. She wants to face many new opponents to see them demonstrate how they battle and with which Pokémon. In addition to the {{badge|Stone}}, Roxanne gives out {{TM|39|Rock Tomb}}. After Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire's [[Delta Episode]], she can also be seen at the [[Fossil Maniac]]'s cave, begging for a [[Fossil]]. She even considers offering him a free Stone Badge in exchange, but quickly restrains herself, despite her desperate desire. According to the [[Television|TV show]] ''Trouble Talk'', she is an expert in Fossils and has been written up in a number of magazines for it. She is also a friend of [[Steven Stone]] and joins stone hunting groups with him, according to a stone seller on {{rt|114|Hoenn}}. In {{B2W2}}, Roxanne appears alongside the other Gym Leaders of [[Hoenn]] as an opponent in the [[Hoenn Leaders Tournament]] at the [[Pokémon World Tournament]]. She also participates alongside the Gym Leaders of [[Kanto]], [[Johto]], Hoenn, [[Sinnoh]] and [[Unova]] in the [[World Leaders Tournament]], and other Rock-type specialists in the Rock [[Type Expert Tournament]]. {{left clear}} ==={{DL|PokéNav|Trainer's Eyes}}/{{DL|PokéNav|Match Call}}=== '''Leader Roxanne'''{{sup/3|RS}}{{sup/6|ORAS}} / '''Rockin' Whiz Roxanne'''{{sup/3|E}} :'''Strategy''' :{{type|Rock}} power attack{{sup/3|RS}} :{{type|Rock}} power attack.{{sup/3|E}} :Attacking with {{type|Rock}} power!{{sup/6|ORAS}} :'''Trainer's Pokémon''' :Rock-solid types are good.{{sup/3|RS}}{{sup/6|ORAS}} :I prefer Rock-hard Pokémon.{{sup/3|E}} :'''Self-Introduction''' :Through battling, I want to learn all about Pokémon.{{sup/3|RS}} :A leader of a big Gym bears a lot of responsibility.{{sup/3|E}} :I want to learn all about Pokémon through battle.{{sup/6|ORAS}} :'''Match Call''' :My gym is ready! {{color2|000|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Roxanne/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Roxanne anime.png|thumb|220px|Roxanne in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'']] ====History==== Roxanne is a top graduate of the [[Rustboro City]] [[Pokémon Trainers' School]], and now teaches the academy's beginner class. She was granted the position of Rustboro [[Gym Leader]] because of her excellent record at the academy, and she allows some of the school's students to undertake internships at the [[Rustboro Gym]]. Roxanne debuted in the {{aniseries|RS}} episode ''[[AG015|Gonna Rule The School!]]''. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} met her when [[Max]] found a lost {{p|Poliwag}} that was soon revealed to belong to the Pokémon Trainers' School. Roxanne then invited the group to the school before Ash's [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}. Roxanne admitted that she was going to be busy teaching her students until tomorrow, and promised she would battle Ash the day after. Ash, Max, and {{an|Brock}} joined Roxanne's students the next day after being invited by the principal, while {{an|May}} studied with the {{pkmn|Contest}} class. {{TRT}} arrived and stole the school's Pokémon, but under Roxanne's watchful eye, her students and Max were able to recover them. She then called on her {{p|Geodude}} and sent Team Rocket blasting off. In ''[[AG016|The Winner by a Nosepass]]'', Ash battled Roxanne at the Rustboro Gym while being filmed by some of Roxanne's students. {{AP|Treecko}} went up against Roxanne's Geodude, but was defeated by its powerful {{m|Mega Punch}} attacks. {{AP|Pikachu}} was able to defeat both of her Pokémon through a combination of pure electrical power and its newly learned {{m|Iron Tail}} technique, which took Roxanne by surprise. Afterwards, Roxanne gave Ash the {{Badge|Stone}} in recognition of his victory. Roxanne is familiar with {{an|Professor Oak}}, as he gives live remote lectures to the students at the school. She also knew about Brock and the [[Pewter Gym]] before she met him, as the Pewter Gym shares her {{type|Rock}} specialty. She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[AG075|Whiscash and Ash]]''. ====Character==== Roxanne enjoys fostering young {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. She offers them real-life experiences, such as filming her [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}s and taking her students on excursions. Roxanne values collaboration, confidence, and consideration in her students and earmarks those qualities as critical to a Trainer's success with handling their Pokémon. She relies on her Pokémon's defenses to overcome a challenger's offensive techniques. Roxanne is perceptive and quickly understands a Trainer's battle strategy when she first sees it. Both of her Pokémon have a wide variety of [[move]]s, allowing Roxanne to launch a range of combinations that take advantage of her opponent's weaknesses. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Roxanne |pkmn=Geodude |type1=Rock |type2=Ground |img=Roxanne Geodude.png |epnum=AG015 |epname=Gonna Rule The School! |vaen=Michael Haigney |desc={{p|Geodude}} debuted in ''[[AG015|Gonna Rule The School!]]'', when Roxanne used it to fight off {{TRT}}. Geodude's only known move is {{m|Mega Punch}}.}} {{anchor|Nosepass 3}}{{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Roxanne |pkmn=Nosepass |type1=Rock |img=Roxanne Nosepass AP.png |epnum=SP19 |epname=Trust In Each Other!! |desc={{p|Nosepass}} was the second Pokémon Roxanne sent out during her Gym battle against Ash.}} ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Roxanne Brawly Adventures.png|thumb|240px|Roxanne in Pokémon Adventures]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== Roxanne is a graduate of the Rustboro Trainers' School and passed with high grades. When {{adv|Sapphire}} arrives at the Gym to obtain her first Badge, she is shocked to find that other challengers are just studying. Roxanne explains that due to having so many challengers, she makes people take tests as a requirement to be able to face her. Sapphire reluctantly takes the test as well, but initially struggles due to her poor literacy skills. With help from advisors on how to read certain words, Sapphire manages to pass her test with flying colors, much to Roxanne's surprise. The two then have their Gym battle against each other. Roxanne faces Sapphire's [[Rono]] with her {{p|Nosepass}}. Sapphire finds that Nosepass is too strong to beat, but is unable to switch due to Nosepass's {{a|Magnet Pull}} Ability. By exploiting Nosepass's inability to face in directions other than north or else it will lose its balance, Sapphire strikes Nosepass from behind and defeats it, earning herself a Stone Badge. Roxanne congratulates Sapphire for her efforts and explains that the Badges can enable Sapphire to take place in the Pokémon League. Later, Roxanne and the other Gym Leaders are called on by [[Flannery]] to meet in [[Fortree City]]. They have a discussion on [[Team Magma]] and [[Team Aqua]] about whether or not one of the teams is evil and the other is good. Roxanne exclaims that her former colleague [[Professor Cozmo]] is being funded by Team Aqua. She claims that since Professor Cozmo would never work with villains, Team Aqua is on the side of good and Team Magma is on the side of evil. [[File:ORAS Gym Leaders Elite Four Adventures.png|thumb|left|170px|Roxanne in the thirteenth chapter]] When {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} are awakened, they begin causing {{a|Drought|droughts}} and {{a|Drizzle|downpours}} throughout Hoenn. Roxanne and [[Brawly]] are sent to the drought-plagued areas to face Groudon in battle. Despite their best efforts, Groudon proves to be too powerful for any of their attacks to damage it. Roxanne manages to prevent Groudon from moving with her Nosepass's {{m|Block}} and continuously attacks it to prevent Groudon from advancing any further. [[Wallace]] also arrives to assist Roxanne and Brawly in attacking Groudon, but all three are interrupted by the [[Magma Admin (Trainer class)#In the manga|Three Fires]] of Team Magma, [[Blaise]], [[Tabitha]], and [[Courtney]]. The three grab Roxanne, Brawly, and Wallace and takes them to [[Lilycove City]] to prevent the Gym Leaders from stopping Groudon any further. Roxanne is dragged to [[Cove Lily Motel]], where Courtney faces her in battle. Roxanne nearly manages to win, but Courtney holds several people hostage and threatens their lives. With no choice but to give up, Roxanne reluctantly allows Courtney to knock her Nosepass out, freeing Groudon from the effects of Block. After both Team Magma and Team Aqua are defeated, with Groudon and Kyogre returning to their deep slumber, Roxanne celebrated the victory with her allies and thanked Sapphire and {{adv|Ruby}} for their assistance in the battle. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== Roxanne, along with various people from around Hoenn, is called to [[Sootopolis City]] to assist in stopping [[Grand Meteor Delta]], a giant meteoroid threatening to destroy the planet. When the plan to attack Grand Meteor Delta starts, Roxanne and the others have their Pokémon attack the meteoroid at the same time. This, combined with the might of [[Mega Evolution|Mega]] {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}, successfully shatters Grand Meteor Delta into pieces. ====Pokémon==== This listing is for Roxanne's Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga. {{anchor|Nosepass 4}}{{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Roxanne |pkmn=Nosepass |gender=female |type1=Rock |img=Roxanne Nosepass Adventures.png |epnum=PS190 |epname=Blowing Past Nosepass I |desc={{p|Nosepass}} is Roxanne's first known Pokémon. It was first used to battle {{adv|Sapphire}}'s [[Rono]] but lost. It helped battle {{p|Groudon}} and stopped it moving with {{m|Block}}, but was later knocked out by [[Courtney]]'s {{p|Ninetales}}, freeing Groudon.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Roxanne |pkmn=Graveler |type1=Rock |type2=Ground |img=Roxanne Graveler Adventures.png |epnum=PS222 |epname=Short Shrift for Shiftry |desc={{p|Graveler}} is Roxanne's second known Pokémon. It was first used to take Roxanne to the Gym Leaders' meeting in [[Fortree City]]. Later, it helped battle against {{p|Groudon}} by using its {{m|Rock Blast}} to prevent Groudon from moving. Graveler's only known move is {{m|Rock Blast}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Roxanne |pkmn=Cradily |type1=Rock |type2=Grass |img=Roxanne Cradily Adventures.png |epnum=PS248 |epname=The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon X |desc={{p|Cradily}} is Roxanne's third known Pokémon. It was first used to battle [[Courtney]]'s {{p|Ninetales}} at the [[Cove Lily Motel]]. Using its {{m|Ingrain}}, Cradily was able to heal from any damage, but was defeated when Courtney took hostages, forcing Roxanne to give up. Cradily's only known move is {{m|Ingrain}}, and its Ability is {{a|Insomnia}}{{tt|*|Cradily cannot legally have Insomnia in the games}}.}} ===Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire=== [[File:Roxanne PMRS.png|thumb|135px|Roxanne in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] Roxanne appeared in ''[[PMRS09|Clefairy's Training Camp!!]]'', where she encountered {{OBP|Red|Pocket Monsters}} as she was carrying groceries. She invited him and his Pokémon to come with her to her [[Gym]], which doubles as a Pokémon School. Roxanne showed them inside, where her {{p|Nosepass}} was reading a book. Roxanne explained that she wanted Nosepass to study hard in order to get a good job elsewhere, but that he was not cooperating the way she wanted. Red and his Pokémon agreed to try and help. After much sightseeing with Nosepass, they managed to have him work as a picnic table. Pleased with the decision, Roxanne wanted to give them the {{badge|Stone}}, but they decided to give her a doughnut instead. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Roxanne's Pokémon in the Pokémon Pocket Monsters manga. {{anchor|Nosepass 5}}{{TrainerPoké |width=81 |main=yes |trainer=Roxanne |pkmn=Nosepass |type1=Rock |img=Roxanne Nosepass PMRS.png |epnum=PMRS09 |epname=Clefairy's Training Camp!! |desc={{p|Nosepass}} is the only Pokémon of Roxanne's seen in the [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]] manga. He is first seen studying in her Gym and later gets a job working as a picnic table.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:RoxanneAstralRadiance188.jpg|200px|thumb|{{TCG|Full Art card|Full Art}} print of Roxanne]] {{main|Roxanne (Astral Radiance 150)}} '''Roxanne''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the {{TCG|Battle Region}} subset before debuting in English in the {{TCG|Astral Radiance}} expansion, the regular print with artwork by [[Megumi Mizutani]], and the {{TCG|Full Art card|Full Art}} and Rainbow Rare prints by [[Sanosuke Sakuma]]. This card can only be played if ones opponent has 3 or fewer {{TCG|Prize card}}s remaining. When played, both players shuffle their hand into their deck. Then, the person who played the card draws 6 cards, and the other player draws 2 cards.
